info.name: Ariba Sourcing - External Approval Approval Tasks API
Ariba Sourcing List Changed Approval Tasks

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm name identifying your site.

params.name: needTotal
params.description: Whether to include total count in X-Total-Count response header.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset from the beginning of the result set for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum page size. Ignored if value is less than 10.

params.name: lastChangeId
params.description: The last change received in the previous response. Response includes all changes since this ID. Default is 0.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Filter approval tasks by solution area and type. See API documentation for supported filter values.

items.docs: Returns a list of external approval tasks that have changed state. Activities that change the state of a task include submitting the task or completing the approval flow. Rate limited to 20 req/sec, 400 req/min, 12000 req/hour, 40000 req/day.

info.name: Ariba Sourcing List Pending Approval Tasks

params.name: realm
params.description: The SAP Ariba realm name identifying your site.

params.name: user
params.description: User ID. If specified, only approval tasks assigned to this user are returned.

params.name: documentType
params.description: Type of document to be approved. Values: Workspace, Folder, RFXDocument, ContractContentDocument, ContractWorkspace, ContractRequest.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point within collection of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records. Range 0-100, default 100.

params.name: resetStartPosition
params.description: When true, returns empty set if offset exceeds total records.

items.docs: Returns a list of external approval tasks that are active and pending approval. Results can be filtered by user ID or document type.

info.name: Ariba Sourcing Get Approval Task Details

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The task ID as returned from GET /changes or GET /pendingApprovables.

items.docs: Retrieves details about the specified external approval task. The entity_id is the task ID returned from GET /changes or GET /pendingApprovables.
Posts the action to be taken for the approval task on behalf of the user in the approval flow. Options are to approve, deny, and include comments.
